Corrosive Ooze.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12. Clear Mind V is not attainable.

Crimson Roar.name: Crimson Roar
Crimson Roar.range: Self only; Moblin Fantocciniman and Fantoccini were not affected despite being next to the Fantoccini Avatar when it was used.
Crimson Roar.notes: Used only by some NM versions of Ifrit; it is not available as a Blood Pact. Thus far, Tejas and Fantoccini Avatar have been confirmed to use this.

Crippling Slam.name: Crippling Slam
Crippling Slam.notes: Only used by Dea, Nihhus, Sentinel Wivre, and Keratyrannos.
Crippling Slam.description: :Deals severe damage to targets in front of it by slamming into them. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Crispy Candle.name: Crispy Candle
Crispy Candle.notes: Also used by Goblins in Dynamis and in the Past. Has a chance to backfire like Bomb Toss (except in Dynamis).
Crispy Candle.description: :Fires a {{Fire|blowtorch}} at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Critical Bite.name: Critical Bite
Critical Bite.notes: More powerful version of Mandible Bite, used only by King Vinegarroon, Serket, and Nightmare Scorpions.
Critical Bite.description: :Deals extreme damage to a single target.

Cronos Sling.name: Cronos Sling
Cronos Sling.description: :Deals damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Cross Attack.name: Cross Attack
Cross Attack.description: :Hits a single target twice in a cross motion.

Cross Reaver.name: Cross Reaver
Cross Reaver.notes: Special weaponskill unique to Ark Angel HM. Deals ~500-900 damage.
Cross Reaver.description: :Deals high damage to players in a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Stun

Crossthrash.name: Crossthrash
Crossthrash.notes: used by Nightmare Tigers in Dynamis - Qufim and Gerjis in the BCNM 50 called Eye of the Tiger. It is believed to be used by some Tiger's NM aswell.
Crossthrash.description: :Damages enemies within area of effect with a twofold attack. Additional effect: Knockback

Crosswind.name: Crosswind
Crosswind.description: :Deals {{Wind}} damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Knockback

Cruel Riposte.name: Cruel Riposte
Cruel Riposte.notes: Used only by Mieuseloir B Enchelles during Campaign.
Cruel Riposte.description: :Drains the life from enemies within range.

Crushing Gaze.name: Crushing Gaze
Crushing Gaze.description: :Slows and weighs down enemies around the caster.'''

Cryo Jet.name: Cryo Jet
Cryo Jet.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Cryo Jet.description: :Releases a freezing blast that deals {{Ice}} damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis

Crystal Rain.name: Crystal Rain
Crystal Rain.description: :Invokes the power of a crystal to deal {{Light}} damage to targets in an area of effect.

Crystal Shield.name: Crystal Shield
Crystal Shield.description: :Invokes the power of a crystal to apply Protect.

Crystal Weapon.name: Crystal Weapon
Crystal Weapon.notes: Can be {{Fire}}, {{Earth}}, {{Wind}}, or {{Water}} element. Functions even at a distance (outside of melee range).
Crystal Weapon.description: :Invokes the power of a crystal to deal magical damage of a random element to a single target.

Crystaline Cocoon.name: Crystaline Cocoon
Crystaline Cocoon.description: :Encases in a crystal to apply Protect & Shell.

Crystalline Flare.name: Crystalline Flare
Crystalline Flare.notes: Only used by Riko Kupenreich. He will Draw In the entire party shortly before using this attack. The stun effect is unusually long.
Crystalline Flare.description: :Deals moderate-high damage to opponents within Area of Effect. Additional Effect: Stun + Blind

Curse (Ghost).name: Curse (Ghost)
Curse (Ghost).notes: Curse has a very long duration.
Curse (Ghost).description: :Inflicts a curse on all targets in an area of effect.

Cursed Sphere.name: Cursed Sphere
Cursed Sphere.notes: When flies use it, it deals dark elemental damage.

Cutpurse.name: Cutpurse
Cutpurse.notes: If it takes off main weapon, anything held in Sub slot is unequipped as well.

Cyclone Wing.name: Cyclone Wing
Cyclone Wing.description: :Deals darkness damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Sleep

Cyclonic Blight.name: Cyclonic Blight
Cyclonic Blight.notes: Only used by Fuath, can give her a multitude of beneficial status effects upon use, including Regain (Status Effect), Regen (Status Effect), Protect (Status Effect) and Shell (Status Effect). Will always heal and Erase Fuath even if it misses or is absorbed.
Cyclonic Blight.description: :Deals {{dark}} {{Verification}} damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Sleep & Stun

Cyclonic Torment.name: Cyclonic Torment
Cyclonic Torment.description: :Deals {{wind}} damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback & Dispel

Cyclonic Torrent.name: Cyclonic Torrent
Cyclonic Torrent.notes: Only used by Urd, Verthandi, and Carabosse. {{Verification}}
Cyclonic Torrent.description: :Area of Effect damage plus Mute to those in range.

Cyclonic Turmoil.name: Cyclonic Turmoil
Cyclonic Turmoil.description: :Deals {{wind}} damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback & Dispel

Cyclotail.name: Cyclotail
Cyclotail.description: :Flails around with its tail, dealing damage to targets in an area of effect.

Cytokinesis.name: Cytokinesis
Cytokinesis.notes: Only used by Blobdingnag and Fistule.

Damnation Dive.name: Damnation Dive
Damnation Dive.notes: Used only by birds in CoP and TOAU areas, and Ghrah in "bird" form.
Damnation Dive.description: :Deals damage in a threefold attack to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Dancing Chains.name: Dancing Chains
Dancing Chains.notes: The damage dealt per tic is 15 HP.
Dancing Chains.description: :Underworldly chains twist and drown all targets in an area of effect.

Dancing Tail.name: Dancing Tail
Dancing Tail.notes: Only uses this ability if the target with hate is out of reach of the dragon's head, such as near its hind legs or directly behind it. See Spike Flail for a similar attack.
Dancing Tail.description: :Deals heavy damage in a single{{Verification}} cone attack to targets behind the user. Additional Effect: Poison (Status Effect)

Dark Arrivisme.name: Dark Arrivisme
Dark Arrivisme.notes: Gains a strong Intimidation effect after use.
Dark Arrivisme.description: :Deals Moderate damage within an area of effect. Additional Effects: Knockback and Dispel (3 buffs).

Dark Invocation.name: Dark Invocation
Dark Invocation.notes: Exact effect(s) of this ability uncertain; used only by certain Campaign leaders and notorious monsters. May rarely be used by ordinary Yagudo populating Campaign areas; one used in West Sarutabaruta by a Yagudo Condottiere did about 400 damage to a 75 RDM/WHM.
Dark Invocation.description: :Deals heavy dark damage to a single target. Additional effect: Doom/Death {{verification}}

Dark Mist.name: Dark Mist
Dark Mist.description: :Releases a gloomy mist that deals darkness damage. Additional effect: Weight

Dark Nova.name: Dark Nova
Dark Nova.notes: Used during his first phase, in his magic stance.
Dark Nova.description: :Dark energy damages targets in an area of effect.

Dark Sphere.name: Dark Sphere
Dark Sphere.description: :Throws an orb of dark energy at a single target. Additional effect: Blind

Dark Spore.name: Dark Spore
Dark Spore.notes: Can be very deadly from higher level funguars. The ability is a Breath attack, and as such is reliant on the current HP of the mob: the more HP, the more damage is dealt.
Dark Spore.description: :Unleashes a torrent of black spores in a fan-shaped area of effect, dealing dark damage to targets. Additional effect: Blind

Dark Star.name: Dark Star
Dark Star.description: :Deals Area of Effect Damage and inflicts those hit with Defense Down and Magic Defense Down

Dark Wave.name: Dark Wave
Dark Wave.notes: Severity of Bio effect varies by time of day, from 8/tic at midday to 20/tic at midnight.
Dark Wave.description: :A wave of dark energy washes over targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bio

Daunting Hurl.name: Daunting Hurl
Daunting Hurl.description: :Tosses a boulder at a single target sometimes causing Terror.

Daydream.name: Daydream
Daydream.notes: Used only by Diabolos Diamond in Dynamis - Tavnazia. Uses it after Nightmare, and the amount of times he uses it is incremental; i.e. once after 1st Nightmare, twice after 2nd Nightmare, etc.

Deadeye.name: Deadeye
Deadeye.notes: Only used by Cheese Hoarder Gigiroon and Cookieduster Lipiroon.
Deadeye.description: :Lowers the defense and magical defense of enemies within range.

Deadly Drive.name: Deadly Drive
Deadly Drive.description: :Deals heavy damage to a single target.

Deadly Hold.name: Deadly Hold
Deadly Hold.description: :Deals critical damage to a single target.

Deafening Tantara.name: Deafening Tantara
Deafening Tantara.notes: Doesn't use this if its horn is broken.
Deafening Tantara.description: :Inflicts silence in an area of effect.

Deal Out.name: Deal Out
Deal Out.notes: Will also reset the hate of everyone within range. (ie : Certain NMs including the ones in Royale Ramble) Also does moderate to heavy damage.

Death Knell.name: Death Knell
Death Knell.notes: Used only by Zolku-Azolku at low health during Campaign.
Death Knell.description: :Pronounces doom on all opponents in range.

Death Prophet.name: Death Prophet
Death Prophet.description: :Attack Boost, Accuracy Boost, Magic Attack Boost, Intension, and a very potent Defense Down aura.

Death Trap.name: Death Trap
Death Trap.notes: Poison effect is generally 10/tick. Start up time is slow, making the ability easy to stun.
Death Trap.description: :Attempts to stun or poison any players in a large trap. Resets hate.

Deathgnash.name: Deathgnash
Deathgnash.notes: Only used by Nuhn and Angler Orobon.
Deathgnash.description: :Chomps on a single target, reducing HP to one and resets enmity.

Deathly Diminuendo.name: Deathly Diminuendo
Deathly Diminuendo.description: :Deals Low to Moderate damage within an area of effect. Additional Effects: Bio {{Status Effect|Bio}} and Curse. {{Status Effect|Curse}}

Decayed Filament.name: Decayed Filament
Decayed Filament.notes: Used only when bars surround it. Poison does 20 damage per tic.
Decayed Filament.description: :Uses toxic fibers to damage any nearby targets. Additional effect: Poison

Decollation.name: Decollation
Decollation.description: :Strikes the head of a single target.

Decussate.name: Decussate
Decussate.notes: Only used by Gulool Ja Ja and Stealthlord Haraal Ja when below 35% health.
Decussate.description: :Performs a cross attack on nearby targets.

Demonic Flower.name: Demonic Flower
Demonic Flower.description: :Deals magic damage to a single target. Effect varies with HP and inflicts caster with weakness.

Demonic Howl.name: Demonic Howl
Demonic Howl.notes: Slow effect is 50%. Can be overwritten and blocked by Haste.
Demonic Howl.description: :Inflicts slow on targets in an area of effect attack.

Depuration.name: Depuration
Depuration.notes: Erases all negative effects on the mob. Aerns will generally not attempt to use this ability if no erasable effects exist on them.

Dereliction.name: Dereliction
Dereliction.description: :Steals HP and MP from enemies within range.

Desiccation.name: Desiccation
Desiccation.description: :Removes most if not all equipment and resets job ability timers. Additional effect: Knockback

Detonating Grip.name: Detonating Grip
Detonating Grip.notes: Loses its right arm upon using this attack.
Detonating Grip.description: :Deals heavy damage to a targets in an area of effect.

Dexter Wing.name: Dexter Wing
Dexter Wing.notes: Only uses this ability if the target is positioned to the right side.
Dexter Wing.description: :Deals damage and knockback in a single cone attack to targets to the right side.

Diabolic Claw.name: Diabolic Claw
Diabolic Claw.notes: Used by a few caturae. Can be avoided by running out of melee range.
Diabolic Claw.description: :Delivers a powerful threefold attack. Additional Effect: Magic Defense Down.

Diamond Shell.name: Diamond Shell
Diamond Shell.notes: Used only by Quadav in WOTG areas.

Diffusion Ray.name: Diffusion Ray
Diffusion Ray.notes: Only used if person with hate is directly in front.

Dire Whorl.name: Dire Whorl
Dire Whorl.notes: Used only by King Goldemar's merchandise.
Dire Whorl.description: :Spins around, damaging targets in an area of effect.

Dirty Breath.name: Dirty Breath
Dirty Breath.description: :Deals magical damage within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Zombie

Dirty Claw.name: Dirty Claw
Dirty Claw.notes: Gieremund's version of this move ignores shadows and dispels a single buff from whoever is hit by it.

Discharge.name: Discharge
Discharge.description: :Releases an {{Lightning|electrical}} discharge at nearby targets. Additional effect: Paralyze

Discharger.name: Discharger
Discharger.notes: Used by Omega at low health (sometimes sooner).

Discoid.name: Discoid
Discoid.notes: Only used by Assailer Chariot, Battleclad Chariot, Battledressed Chariot, and Pandemonium Warden.
Discoid.description: :Releases a fragmenting disc that deals fixed magical damage to players in an area of effect.

Disgorge.name: Disgorge
Disgorge.notes: Damage is based on how much Gorge drains.

Dismemberment.name: Dismemberment
Dismemberment.notes: Removes a part of its own body each time this is used.

Disorienting Waul.name: Disorienting Waul
Disorienting Waul.description: :Inflicts Amnesia on targets in an area of effect.

Dispelling Wind.name: Dispelling Wind
Dispelling Wind.description: :Dispels two effects from targets in an area of effect.

Dissipation.name: Dissipation
Dissipation.notes: Used only by Proto-Ultima at 79%, 59%, 39%, and 19% HP. Can be Stunned if watched closely.
Dissipation.description: :Dissipates all buffs from players in a wide radius. Additional effect: Terror + Enmity Reset

Dissolve.name: Dissolve
Dissolve.notes: Only used by Blobdingnag, Morbid Molasses, and Fistule. The enmity of the NM's target when this move is used will be erased a few seconds after the move is executed. Peripheral targets that are hit by this attack will not have their enmity reset.
Dissolve.description: :Absorbs the HP of players in range.

Divine Favor.name: Divine Favor
Divine Favor.notes: Only used by Cait Sith Ceithir.

Divine Judgment.name: Divine Judgment
Divine Judgment.notes: Used when Alexander is at 50% health, and may use it again when at low health. Can deal over 1000 damage. Used several times like an Astral Flow blood pact, but without regard to time. As he uses this ability, Alexander will announce:
Divine Judgment.description: :Deals heavy {{Light}} damage to targets in an area of effect.

Divine Spear.name: Divine Spear
Divine Spear.notes: Only used if player with hate is in front. Sometimes accompanied by the text:
Divine Spear.description: :Deals {{Light}} damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Attack Down

Dominion Slash.name: Dominion Slash
Dominion Slash.notes: Special weaponskill unique to Ark Angel EV. Deals ~200-300 damage.
Dominion Slash.description: :Performs an area of effect slashing weaponskill. Additional effect: Silence

Doom (Yagudo).name: Doom (Yagudo)
Doom (Yagudo).notes: Only used by named NM Yagudo in Dynamis, as well as Dee Xalmo the Grim when he's at low health. Unlike Mortal Ray and Eternal Damnation, this is not a gaze attack.

Doomvoid.name: Doomvoid

They are then warped to either Everbloom Hollow, Ghoyu's Reverie, or Ruhotz Silvermines, depending on region. Once this ability is completed, the Sandworm will automatically die.
Doomvoid.description: :Players are drawn-in and swallowed whole, transporting them to an underground area.

Double Kick.name: Double Kick
Double Kick.notes: Stun may or may not take effect.
Double Kick.description: :Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun

Double Ray.name: Double Ray
Double Ray.description: :An energy ray zaps a single target.

Dragon Breath.name: Dragon Breath
Dragon Breath.notes: Used only by Fafnir, Nidhogg, Cynoprosopi, Wyrm, and Trust: Areuhat. Because of the high damage output from Fafnir/Nidhogg/Wyrm, it is usually avoided by standing on (or near) the wyrm's two front feet. Cynoprosopi's breath attack is much less painful.
Dragon Breath.description: :Deals {{Fire}} damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Dragonfall.name: Dragonfall
Dragonfall.notes: Special weaponskill unique to Ark Angel GK. Deals ~100-300 damage.
Dragonfall.description: :Deals damage to players an area of effect. Additional effect: Bind

Drain Whip.name: Drain Whip
Drain Whip.notes: Used by Capricious Cassie, Voluptuous Vivian and Eccentric Eve.
Drain Whip.description: :Drains HP, MP, or TP from the target.

Drainkiss.name: Drainkiss
Drainkiss.notes: If used against undead, it will simply do damage and not drain HP.
Drainkiss.description: :Deals dark damage to a single target. Additional effect: Drain

Draw In.name: Draw In
Draw In.notes: There are two forms of the Draw In ability:

Dread Dive.name: Dread Dive
Dread Dive.notes: Used instead of Gliding Spike by certain notorious monsters.
Dread Dive.description: :Dives into a single target. Additional effect: Knockback + Stun

Dread Shriek.name: Dread Shriek
Dread Shriek.description: :An unsettling shriek paralyzes targets in an area of effect.

Dread Wind.name: Dread Wind
Dread Wind.description: :Creates a whirlwind that deals {{Wind}} damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Terror

Dreadstorm.name: Dreadstorm
Dreadstorm.description: :Deals magical damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Terror

Drill Branch.name: Drill Branch
Drill Branch.description: :Drills a single target with a branch. Additional effect: Blind

Droning Whirlwind.name: Droning Whirlwind
Droning Whirlwind.description: :Deals {{wind}} damage to enemies within area of effect. Additional effect: Dispel.

Dual Strike.name: Dual Strike
Dual Strike.description: :Double attacks a single target. Additional effect: Stun

Dukkeripen.name: Dukkeripen
Dukkeripen.notes: Used only by Corsair Lamiae, this does one of three things: Heals the Lamia, grants it 10 shadows, or AOE paralyze every opponent.

Dust Cloud.name: Dust Cloud
Dust Cloud.description: :Deals {{earth}} damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Blind

Dustvoid.name: Dustvoid
Dustvoid.description: :Removes most if not all equipment. Additional effect: Knockback

Dynamic Implosion.name: Dynamic Implosion
Dynamic Implosion.description: :Deals damage to players within an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun (Status Effect)

Earth Blade.name: Earth Blade
Earth Blade.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enstone aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Earth Breath.name: Earth Breath
Earth Breath.description: :Deals {{Earth}} damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Earth Pounder.name: Earth Pounder
Earth Pounder.description: :Deals {{Earth}} damage to enemies within area of effect. Additional effect: Dexterity Down

Earth Shock.name: Earth Shock
Earth Shock.description: :Creates a seismic wave to damage targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Earthbreaker.name: Earthbreaker
Earthbreaker.notes: Stronger version of Earth Pounder, used only by Serket, King Vinegarroon, and Nightmare Scorpions.
Earthbreaker.description: :Deals {{Earth}} damage to enemies within massive area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Earthshatter.name: Earthshatter
Earthshatter.description: :Deals damage to a targets in an area of effect.

Ecliptic Meteor.name: Ecliptic Meteor
Ecliptic Meteor.notes: Only used by Hadhayosh and Kholomodumo
Ecliptic Meteor.description: :Summons a meteor to smash the opposition. Additional effect: Paralysis + Bio + Blind

Ectosmash.name: Ectosmash
Ectosmash.notes: Mob is still set to same spot for attacks and abilities that deal with monster position, such as Sneak Attack and Cover. Monster will always return to this starting position after.
Ectosmash.description: :Teleports in to smack a single target

Edge of Death.name: Edge of Death
Edge of Death.notes: Used only by the genji armor NMs during Feast of Swords event.

Efflorescent Foetor.name: Efflorescent Foetor
Efflorescent Foetor.description: :Sprays toxic pollen in a fan-shaped area of effect, inflicting Blind & Silence.

Electrocharge.name: Electrocharge
Electrocharge.description: :Fires an {{Lightning|electrical}} burst at a single target.

Electromagnetic Field.name: Electromagnetic Field
Electromagnetic Field.description: :An electromagnetic pulse damages all targets in an area of effect.

Emetic Discharge.name: Emetic Discharge
Emetic Discharge.notes: Only used by Bloodlapper and Brummbar.

Empty Beleaguer.name: Empty Beleaguer
Empty Beleaguer.description: :Erratically darts around, dealing damage to nearby targets.

Empty Kiss.name: Empty Kiss
Empty Kiss.description: :Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Poison + Plague

Empty Salvation.name: Empty Salvation
Empty Salvation.description: :Damages all targets in range with the salvation of emptiness. Additional effect: Dispels 3 effects

Empty Seed.name: Empty Seed
Empty Seed.notes: The knockback can push players very far.
Empty Seed.description: :Releases a powerful shockwave at players in a large radius. Additional effect: Knockback

Energy Screen.name: Energy Screen
Energy Screen.notes: Used only by Proto-Ultima during phases 4 and 5.
Energy Screen.description: :Grants immunity to physical attacks for a time.

Enervating Grasp.name: Enervating Grasp
Enervating Grasp.description: :Delivers an area attack that inflicts paralysis, bind, and Defense Down.

Entangle.name: Entangle
Entangle.notes: When used by the Cemetery Cherry & Jidra, it also deals damage, inflicts Poison, and resets hate. When used by Cernunnos, also drains HP equal to the damage inflicted.
Entangle.description: :Attempts to bind a single target with vines.

Enthrall.name: Enthrall
Enthrall.notes: Used only by Rani. Anyone charmed with this ability will also gain the effect of Sippoy Costume.
Enthrall.description: :Charm's {{Status Effect|Charm}} all players in an area of effect. Additional Effect: Sippoy costume.

Envoutement.name: Envoutement
Envoutement.description: :Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Curse

Epoxy Spread.name: Epoxy Spread
Epoxy Spread.notes: Only used by clots in the Near East, Hematic Cyst, and Blobdingnag.
Epoxy Spread.description: :Splashes around a binding resin in an area of effect.

Equalizer (Ultima).name: Equalizer (Ultima)
Equalizer (Ultima).notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima (after sustaining considerable damage).
Equalizer (Ultima).description: :Deals heavy damage to players with a spinning attack.

Erosion Dust.name: Erosion Dust
Erosion Dust.notes: Dia effect is equivalent to Dia III. The damage dealt per tic, however, is 11 damage.
Erosion Dust.description: :Spreads eroding dust particles on targets in an area of effect, dealing {{Light}} damage and inflicting Dia.

Eternal Damnation.name: Eternal Damnation
Eternal Damnation.description: :Dooms those within a conic Area of Effect with a glare.

Evasion (Scorpion).name: Evasion (Scorpion)
Evasion (Scorpion).notes: Used by Serket and Nightmare Scorpions.

Everyone's Grudge (ability).name: Everyone's Grudge (ability)

Everyone's Grudge (ability).description: :Invokes collective hatred to spite a single target.

Everyone's Rancor.name: Everyone's Rancor
Everyone's Rancor.notes: Damage is 50x the amount of Tonberries slain. Only used by certain Notorious Monsters, generally only once and when they have reached a certain percentage of HP (usually 25%).
Everyone's Rancor.description: :Invokes rancor to spite a single target.

Extreme Purgation.name: Extreme Purgation
Extreme Purgation.notes: Steals both positive and negative status effects.
Extreme Purgation.description: :Purges all status effect from players in an area of effect.

Extremely Bad Breath.name: Extremely Bad Breath
Extremely Bad Breath.notes: Only used by Evil Oscar, Cirrate Christelle, Lividroot Amooshah, Eccentric Eve, Deranged Ameretat, and Melancholic Moira.
Extremely Bad Breath.description: :A horrific case of halitosis instantly K.O.'s any players in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Eye Scratch.name: Eye Scratch
Eye Scratch.description: :Scratches a single target right in the eyes. Additional effect: Blind

Fanatic Dance.name: Fanatic Dance
Fanatic Dance.notes: Only used by named NM's in Dynamis and Falsespinner Bhudbrodd in La Vaule (S).
Fanatic Dance.description: :Charms all targets in an area of effect.

Fang Rush.name: Fang Rush
Fang Rush.description: :Deals major damage with a threefold attack to a single target.

Fatal Scream.name: Fatal Scream
Fatal Scream.notes: Used by Chloris and Pancimanci and Annihilative Adenium.
Fatal Scream.description: A high-pitched scream that dooms nearby targets.

Faze.name: Faze
Faze.notes: Attack is sight-based. Turning from the mob causes it to have no effect on your character.

Fear Touch.name: Fear Touch
Fear Touch.description: :Touches a single target. Additional effect: Slow

Feather Maelstrom.name: Feather Maelstrom
Feather Maelstrom.notes: Used only by the Seed Yagudo.
Feather Maelstrom.description: :Sends a storm of feathers to a single target. Additional effect: Bio & Amnesia

Feather Tickle.name: Feather Tickle
Feather Tickle.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12. Clear Mind V is not attainable.

Feathered Furore.name: Feathered Furore
Feathered Furore.notes: Used only by Yagudo in WOTG areas. It will randomly remove one piece of visible equipment (i.e. anything other than accessories or ranged/ammo), and will also remove any shield/grip/sub-weapon if the main weapon is knocked off. However, this ability has a chance to miss. It has no effect on pets or NPC defenders.
Feathered Furore.description: :Removes one random piece of equipment from players in a fan shaped area.

Feeble Bleat.name: Feeble Bleat
Feeble Bleat.notes: Used only by the Karakul in the Near East.
Feeble Bleat.description: :Emits a unnerving bleat that paralyzes all in range.

Feral Peck.name: Feral Peck
Feral Peck.notes: Deals a set amount of heavy damage (seems like ~90% of target's current HP) to a single target. Used only by Zirnitra and Turul.
Feral Peck.description: :Deals extreme damage to a single target.

Fevered Pitch.name: Fevered Pitch
Fevered Pitch.description: :Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun and Defense Down

Fiery Blast.name: Fiery Blast
Fiery Blast.notes: Ranged Magical Fire Damage. Can be reduced by fire resist set, Carol, Barfira and MDT. Used in flight by Wyrms.

Filamented Hold.name: Filamented Hold
Filamented Hold.notes: Unlike other job traits, the effect stack for each pair in this group. Each set gives the next tier of Clear Mind for an additional MP Recovered While Healing + 3 effect. A maximum of Clear Mind IV can be achieved granting a max bonus of MP Recovered While Healing +12. Clear Mind V is not attainable.

Final Retribution.name: Final Retribution
Final Retribution.notes: Only used by some notorious monsters like Xolotl.
Final Retribution.description: :Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Fire Angon.name: Fire Angon
Fire Angon.description: :Throws a fiery angon, dealing {{Fire}} damage to targets in an area of effect.

Fire Arrow (Warmachine).name: Fire Arrow (Warmachine)
Fire Arrow (Warmachine).description: :Fires a burning arrow at a single target.

Fire Blade.name: Fire Blade
Fire Blade.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enfire aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Fire Break.name: Fire Break
Fire Break.description: :Deals heavy {{Fire}} damage to targets in front.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description: :Deals {{Fire}} damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Firebomb.name: Firebomb
Firebomb.description: :Launches an explosive, dealing {{Fire}} damage to all targets in an area of effect.

Fission.name: Fission
Fission.notes: Only used by notorious monsters; the name of the offspring depends on which NM uses it.

Flailing Trunk.name: Flailing Trunk
Flailing Trunk.description: :Smacks around frontward targets with its trunk.

Flame Armor.name: Flame Armor
Flame Armor.description: :Covers the user in {{Fire|fiery spikes}}. Enemies that hit it take fire damage.

Flame Blast.name: Flame Blast
Flame Blast.notes: Used only by Wyrm when he's in the sky.
Flame Blast.description: :A fire storm deals {{Fire}} damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Flame Breath.name: Flame Breath
Flame Breath.description: :Deals {{Fire}} damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Flame Thrower.name: Flame Thrower
Flame Thrower.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Flame Thrower.description: :Uses a flamethrower that deals {{Fire}} damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Plague

Floodlight.name: Floodlight
Floodlight.notes: Used only by Proto-Omega (when standing upright).
Floodlight.description: :Brightly {{Light|illuminates}} an area of effect, damaging players in range. Additional effects: Flash + Blind + Silence

Floral Bouquet.name: Floral Bouquet
Floral Bouquet.notes: Monsters may be charmed by this move.
Floral Bouquet.description: :Puts enemies in area of effect to sleep. Charms nearby monsters.

Flowerpot (Ability).name: Flowerpot (Ability)
Flowerpot (Ability).notes: Only used by the Henchman Moogles.
Flowerpot (Ability).description: :Drops a flowerpot on an enemy, disorientating them. Additional Effect: Blind, Stun, and Amnesia

Fluid Spread.name: Fluid Spread
Fluid Spread.description: :Splashes around liquid in an area of effect.

Fluid Toss.name: Fluid Toss
Fluid Toss.notes: Damage appears to vary with TP.
Fluid Toss.description: :Lobs a ball of liquid at a single target.

Fluorescence.name: Fluorescence
Fluorescence.notes: Boost effect is extremely powerful- recommend dispelling the effect if not relying on Blink or Utsusemi shadows.

Flurry of Rage.name: Flurry of Rage
Flurry of Rage.notes: Only used by Eldritch Edge, Malefic Fencer, and Nightmare Weapon.
Flurry of Rage.description: :Deals multiple hits to a single target.

Forceful Blow.name: Forceful Blow
Forceful Blow.notes: Only used by unarmed Mamool Ja of the warrior class (THF, NIN, BLU, BST, DRG).{{verification}}
Forceful Blow.description: :Delivers a powerful strike to a single target.

Formation Attack.name: Formation Attack
Formation Attack.notes: Damage depends on how many individual bombs remain.{{verification}}

Fortifying Wail.name: Fortifying Wail
Fortifying Wail.description: :Let's out a wail that applies Protect to itself and nearby allies.

Foul Breath.name: Foul Breath
Foul Breath.notes: One of the three possible breath moves used by raptors, the other two being Frost Breath and Thunderbolt. Any raptor can only use one of these moves; which breath is used is dependent on the overall climate of the area the raptor is in. Foul Breath is used by raptors in dry desert/mountainous areas, such as Meriphataud Mountains and Cape Teriggan.
Foul Breath.description: :Deals {{Fire}} damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Disease

Fountain.name: Fountain
Fountain.description: :Fires a high pressure stream of water, dealing {{Water}} damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Foxfire.name: Foxfire
Foxfire.notes: Only used by Fomors that wield a one-handed weapon (principally RDM, THF, PLD, BST, BRD, RNG, NIN, and COR fomors).
Foxfire.description: :Strikes frontal targets with a luminous wave. Additional effect: Stun

Fragrant Breath.name: Fragrant Breath
Fragrant Breath.notes: Used by Cirrate Christelle in Dynamis - Valkurm (shorter duration if Nant'ina was defeated).
Fragrant Breath.description: :An aromatic scent is exhaled to charms any players in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Freeze Rush.name: Freeze Rush
Freeze Rush.description: :Makes an {{Ice|icy}} charge at a single target.

Frenzy Pollen.name: Frenzy Pollen
Frenzy Pollen.notes: Used only by Nightmare Hornets in Dynamis - Tavnazia and the Chasmic Hornet in Abyssea - La Theine.

Frigid Shuffle.name: Frigid Shuffle
Frigid Shuffle.description: :An icy waltz paralyzes targets in an area of effect.

Frog Cheer.name: Frog Cheer
Frog Cheer.notes: Elemental Seal effect wears off after one spell is cast.
Frog Cheer.description: :Increases magical attack and grants Elemental Seal effect.

Frog Chorus.name: Frog Chorus
Frog Chorus.description: Grants a Poroggo costume while charmed. Only used by certain Poroggo NMs.

Frog Song.name: Frog Song
Frog Song.notes: Grants a poroggo costume while charmed.
Frog Song.description: :Charms target and transforms them into a frog.

Frost Blade.name: Frost Blade
Frost Blade.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut. Enblizzard aspect adds 70+ to his melee attacks.

Frozen Mist.name: Frozen Mist
Frozen Mist.description: :Releases a {{Ice|very cold}} mist that deals damage and terror. Additional effect: Physical Shield on self. Can also randomly remove 1-3 pieces of equipment.

Full-Force Blow.name: Full-Force Blow
Full-Force Blow.description: :Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Knockback.

Fulmination.name: Fulmination
Fulmination.notes: Uses only when Khimaira is at 35% health or less. Tyger will use under 50% health or less.
Fulmination.description: :Deals heavy magical damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis + Stun

Furious Flurry.name: Furious Flurry
Furious Flurry.notes: Used only by some notorious monsters.
Furious Flurry.description: :Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Weight and Silence

Fuscous Ooze.name: Fuscous Ooze
Fuscous Ooze.notes: This attack prevents equipment from being changed, but no longer strips targets of equipment.
Fuscous Ooze.description: :A dusky slime inflicts encumberance and weight.

Gagnrath.name: Gagnrath
Gagnrath.notes: Odin will say a random speech before using this move.
Gagnrath.description: :Damage players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Terror

Gala Macabre.name: Gala Macabre
Gala Macabre.notes: Only used by some notorious monsters like Xolotl and Giltine.
Gala Macabre.description: :Charms all targets in an area of effect.

Gas Shell.name: Gas Shell
Gas Shell.notes: Poison is about 24/tic. The Nightmare Uragnite uses an enhanced version that also inflicts Plague.
Gas Shell.description: :Releases a toxic gas from its shell, poisoning targets in an area of effect.

Gastric Bomb.name: Gastric Bomb
Gastric Bomb.description: :Deals {{Water}} damage with a long-range acid bomb. Additional effect: Attack Down

Gates of Hades.name: Gates of Hades
Gates of Hades.notes: Only used when a cerberus's health is 25% or lower (may not be the case for Orthrus{{Verification}}). The burn effect takes off upwards of 20 HP per tick.

Geirrothr (ability).name: Geirrothr (ability)
Geirrothr (ability).notes: Odin uses this ability every time he loses 25% of health. Equivalent of 10000 Needles. Before using this move, he has a monologue: "The true power of Gungnir cometh not from the blade herself, but from the countless souls it hath sent to the corpse-halls of the Underworld!"
Geirrothr (ability).description: :Damages fixed damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bind + Stun{{verification}}

Geotic Breath.name: Geotic Breath
Geotic Breath.notes: Used only by Earth Wyrms such as Ouryu and Dragua when they are on the ground.
Geotic Breath.description: :Deals {{earth}} damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Giga Scream.name: Giga Scream
Giga Scream.notes: Used by some notorious monsters in place of Triple Attack.
Giga Scream.description: :Delivers a threefold attack on a single target.

Giga Slash.name: Giga Slash
Giga Slash.notes: Used during his first phase, in his melee stance.

Gigaflare.name: Gigaflare
Gigaflare.notes: Used by Bahamut when down to 10% of health instead of Megaflare during Storms of Fate event. In The Wyrmking Descends, he uses this starting from 60%. Makes a statement before using this move, depending on version:
Gigaflare.description: :Deals massive {{fire}} damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Glacial Breath.name: Glacial Breath
Glacial Breath.notes: Used only by Jormungand when he's on the ground.
Glacial Breath.description: :Deals {{ice}} damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Glacier Splitter.name: Glacier Splitter
Glacier Splitter.notes: Only used the Aern wielding a sword (RDM, DRK, and PLD).
Glacier Splitter.description: :Cleaves into targets in a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Paralyze

Gliding Spike.name: Gliding Spike
Gliding Spike.description: :Strikes a single target with a spike. Additional effect: Knockback + Stun

Gloom Phantom Rush.name: Gloom Phantom Rush
Gloom Phantom Rush.notes: Likely very similar to Goblin Rush, just used by and named for a specific type of Goblin.

Gnash.name: Gnash
Gnash.description: :Chews on a single target, reducing HP to one half.

Goblin Dice.name: Goblin Dice
Goblin Dice.notes: Causes a completely random effect on players: Sleep, Slow, Dispel, Disease, Stun, Poison, damage, drop TP to 0, Benediction, or recharge abilities. Used only by Vanguard goblins in Dynamis, the Moblin Fantocciniman or the summoned goblin Choplix.
Goblin Dice.description: :Deals a random effect based on the roll of the dice.

Goddess's Shield.name: Goddess's Shield
Goddess's Shield.notes: Used by Campaign physician units under correct conditions; this allows them to cast self-targeting spells like Blink and Phalanx on allied targets.
Goddess's Shield.description: :Enables self-target spells to be cast on players and allies.

Gorge.name: Gorge
Gorge.notes: The total HP drained from Gorge will affect the damage dealt from Disgorge.
Gorge.description: :Drains HP from all targets within range.

Gorgon Dance.name: Gorgon Dance
Gorgon Dance.notes: Used only by Medusa. Starts using it at 25%.
Gorgon Dance.description: :Petrifies all targets in an area of effect.

Gospel of the Lost.name: Gospel of the Lost
Gospel of the Lost.notes: Has a narrow window where it can be stunned. When he uses this, he will say:

Grace of Hera.name: Grace of Hera
Grace of Hera.notes: Used by Auroral Alicorn. The Regen effect is 25 HP/tick.
Grace of Hera.description: :A surge of {{Light}} is directed at targets in an area of effect around Auroral Alicorn granting a Regen effect and removing harmful status effects.

Granite Skin.name: Granite Skin
Granite Skin.description: :Enhances defense and guarding skill (nullifies all physical damage from the front).

Grapple.name: Grapple
Grapple.description: :Deals physical damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area originating from pet.

Grating Tantara.name: Grating Tantara
Grating Tantara.notes: Doesn't use this if its horn is broken. Used only by certain Imp NMs, in place of Abrasive Tantara.
Grating Tantara.description: :Inflicts amnesia in an area of effect and deals damage.

Grave Reel.name: Grave Reel
Grave Reel.description: :Steals HP from all targets in an area of effect.

Gravitic Horn.name: Gravitic Horn
Gravitic Horn.notes: Reset Enmity. After using this ability Orcus gains aura which inflicts Weight & Defense Down to targets in range. Also used by Myrmeleontide and Antiphus.
Gravitic Horn.description: :Unleashes heavy {{Wind|wind}} damage from its huge mandible to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Reset Enmity.

Gravity Field.name: Gravity Field
Gravity Field.description: :Slows down targets in an area of effect.

Gravity Wheel.name: Gravity Wheel
Gravity Wheel.description: :Deals heavy damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Weight

Great Bleat.name: Great Bleat
Great Bleat.description: :Lowers maximum HP of targets in an area of effect.

Great Sandstorm.name: Great Sandstorm
Great Sandstorm.description: :Deals {{Wind}} damage to single target. Additional effect: Blind

Great Wheel.name: Great Wheel
Great Wheel.notes: Used only by Kam'lanaut and Trust: Mildaurion.
Great Wheel.description: :Deals damage to players within an area of effect. Additional effect: Enmity reset

Great Whirlwind.name: Great Whirlwind
Great Whirlwind.description: :Deals {{Wind}} damage to targets in front. Additional effect: Choke

Gregale Wing.name: Gregale Wing
Gregale Wing.notes: Used only by Jormungand in the air and on the ground and by Isgebind.
Gregale Wing.description: :An icy wind deals {{ice}} damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Paralyze

Grim Glower.name: Grim Glower
Grim Glower.dispel: Only with Blind or Blind II.
Grim Glower.notes: The peiste eyes will be brightly glowing while this is in effect. Anyone facing it will be petrified until it ends or it turns away. (Petrify may wear off before the Peiste's eyes stop glowing; you will have a second or so to quickly turn your back.)
Grim Glower.description: :Stares with glowing eyes that petrifies any target that makes eye contact.

Grim Halo.name: Grim Halo
Grim Halo.notes: Only used by Fomors that wield a two-handed weapon (principally WAR, BLM, DRK, SAM, DRG, and SMN fomors).
Grim Halo.description: :Deals heavy damage to all targets with a circular strike. Additional effect: Knockback

Grim Reaper.name: Grim Reaper
Grim Reaper.notes: Used only by certain Lamia NMs (e.g. Lamia No.3). If they lost their staff, they'll use Hysteric Barrage instead.
Grim Reaper.description: :Deals damage in a threefold attack to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Doom

Groundburst.name: Groundburst
Groundburst.notes: Only used by notorious monsters, and from any Mamool Ja in besieged.
Groundburst.description: :Expels a {{Fire|fireball}} on targets in an area of effect.

Guided Missile.name: Guided Missile
Guided Missile.description: :Targets players within an area of effect with a missile. Additional effect: Bind{{verification}}

Guided Missile II.name: Guided Missile II
Guided Missile II.notes: Used only by Proto-Omega and Pantokrator.
Guided Missile II.description: :Targets players within an area of effect with a missile. Additional effect: Bind{{verification}}

Gusting Gouge.name: Gusting Gouge
Gusting Gouge.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a one-handed weapon. If they lost their weapon, they'll use Hysteric Barrage instead.
Gusting Gouge.description: :Deals {{Wind}} damage in a threefold attack to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Hammer Beak.name: Hammer Beak
Hammer Beak.description: :Deals heavy damage to a single target.

Hammer-Go-Round.name: Hammer-Go-Round
Hammer-Go-Round.description: :Damages nearby targets with a hammer carousel. Additional effect: Knockback

Hammerblow.name: Hammerblow
Hammerblow.description: :Swings the hammer right at a single target.

Hane Fubuki.name: Hane Fubuki
Hane Fubuki.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless instead of Feather Storm. Also used by Trust: Gessho. Hane Fubuki is literally translated as "feather blizzard," possibly a pun on hanafubuki.
Hane Fubuki.description: :Sends a barrage of feathers to a single target. Additional effect: Poison

Happobarai.name: Happobarai
Happobarai.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless instead of Sweep. Also used by Trust: Gessho.
Happobarai.description: :Damages enemies in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Havoc Spiral.name: Havoc Spiral
Havoc Spiral.notes: Special weaponskill unique to Ark Angel MR. Deals ~100-300 damage.
Havoc Spiral.description: :Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Sleep

Haymaker.name: Haymaker
Haymaker.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing.
Haymaker.description: :Punches the daylights out of all targets in front. Additional effect: Amnesia

Head Butt (Adamantoise).name: Head Butt (Adamantoise)
Head Butt (Adamantoise).notes: This is not the learnable Blue Mage spell Head Butt. The correct version is used by Quadav enemies.
Head Butt (Adamantoise).description: :Deals damage to single target. Additional effects: Accuracy Down and large knockback

Head Snatch.name: Head Snatch
Head Snatch.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing. Reduces HP to 10%.

Heat Barrier.name: Heat Barrier
Heat Barrier.dispel: Can be Dispelled with Geist Wall
Heat Barrier.notes: Blaze Spikes can inflict 50-67 damage from Wamoura Prince. In Bhaflau Remnants Salvage, the Wamouracampas' Blaze Spikes effect is far less powerful.
Heat Barrier.description: :Applies a thermal barrier, granting {{Fire|fiery spikes}} and fire damage on melee hits.

Heat Wave.name: Heat Wave
Heat Wave.description: :Burns opponents in an area of effect.

Heavy Artillery.name: Heavy Artillery
Heavy Artillery.notes: Fired by an Orcish Turret's central cannon.
Heavy Artillery.description: :Fires an explosive artillery shell that blasts targets in an area of effect.

Heavy Bellow.name: Heavy Bellow
Heavy Bellow.description: :Stuns all targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Heavy Stomp.name: Heavy Stomp
Heavy Stomp.notes: Paralysis effect has a very long duration.
Heavy Stomp.description: :Deals heavy damage to targets within an area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis

Heavy Whisk.name: Heavy Whisk
Heavy Whisk.description: :Swiftly strikes a single target. Additional effect: Knockback

Heliovoid.name: Heliovoid
Heliovoid.description: :Absorbs one status effect from all players in range.

Hell Scissors.name: Hell Scissors
Hell Scissors.notes: TP move similar to Throat Stab. Used only by Khadem Quemquoma, Vaa Oozu's Scolopendrid, Centipedal Centruroides, Hedetet, Hedjedjet and Transcendent Scorpion. Has a longer readying time than Death Scissors, and can be outran.
Hell Scissors.description: :Deals extreme damage to a single target. Additional Effect: Hate Reset

Hellborn Yawp.name: Hellborn Yawp
Hellborn Yawp.notes: Only used by Shadowsoul, Abununnu and Count Bifrons.
Hellborn Yawp.description: :Activates a shield to absorb all incoming damage.

Hellclap.name: Hellclap
Hellclap.description: :Deals magical damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Weight

Hellish Crescendo.name: Hellish Crescendo
Hellish Crescendo.description: :Deals Low to Moderate damage within an area of effect. Additional Effect: Paralyze. {{Status Effect|Paralyze}}

Hellsnap.name: Hellsnap
Hellsnap.notes: Often used as a prelude to a special ability (e.g. Pandemonium Warden's form change).
Hellsnap.description: :Stuns targets in an area of effect.

Hellstorm.name: Hellstorm
Hellstorm.notes: Damage is based on bomb's current HP.
Hellstorm.description: :Deals {{Fire}} damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Hex Palm.name: Hex Palm
Hex Palm.notes: Used only when fighting with fists.

Hexagon Belt.name: Hexagon Belt
Hexagon Belt.description: :Applies an ethereal belt to increase defense.

Hexidiscs.name: Hexidiscs
Hexidiscs.description: :A sixfold attack damages targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Hi-Freq Field.name: Hi-Freq Field
Hi-Freq Field.description: :Lowers the evasion of enemies in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Hiden Sokyaku.name: Hiden Sokyaku
Hiden Sokyaku.notes: Used only by Gessho & Kazan the Peerless instead of Double Kick.
Hiden Sokyaku.description: :Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun

Hiemal Storm.name: Hiemal Storm
Hiemal Storm.description: :Blasts a harsh {{Ice|wintry}} wind at enemies in a fan-shaped area of effect.

High-Tension Discharger.name: High-Tension Discharger
High-Tension Discharger.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
High-Tension Discharger.description: :Discharges a powerful current that deals {{Lightning}} damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Homing Missile.name: Homing Missile
Homing Missile.notes: Only used by Long-Bowed Chariot, Long-Gunned Chariot, and Long-Barreled Chariot. Cuts HP by 90% to whomever it hits. Only uses it if person with hate is in front of it. The ability can be decreased in strength to a mildly damaging radial ability with no enmity reset in Salvage in Bhaflau Remnants if the ten single Archaic Gears on the previous floor are defeated; defeating less than ten still reduces the strength of the ability, but does not remove the enmity reset.
Homing Missile.description: :Fires missiles that deals massive damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Enmity reset

Hoof Volley.name: Hoof Volley
Hoof Volley.notes: Used only by NM's and Grauberg Hippogryphs. May be used immediately after one of its other TP moves.
Hoof Volley.description: :Deals critical damage to a single target. Resets hate and causes knockback.

Horrible Roar.name: Horrible Roar
Horrible Roar.notes: Used by Bahamut during The Wyrmking Descends BCNM. Dispels up to 4 effects, including food.
Horrible Roar.description: :Removes several beneficial effects from players in an area of effect.

Horrid Roar.name: Horrid Roar
Horrid Roar.notes: The effect varies slightly by which wyrm used this ability:
Horrid Roar.description: :Removes beneficial effects from a single target and reduces enmity.

Horror Cloud.name: Horror Cloud
Horror Cloud.notes: Can be overwritten and blocked by Haste.
Horror Cloud.description: :A debilitating cloud slows the attack speed of a single target.

Howl.name: Howl
Howl.range: Self and nearby mobs of same family and/or force up to 20'.
Howl.notes: Unlike the Warrior's job ability, this expends the mob's TP as a weapon skill rather than function as a job ability. Much like the job ability, this applies to all nearby members of the same family, and any other mobs linked with it (e.g. warmachines). In Campaign Battles, it applies to all members of the Beastmen Confederate in its range.
Howl.description: :Grants the effect of Warcry to user and any linked allies.

Howling.name: Howling
Howling.description: :Paralyzes enemies in an area of effect.

Hungry Crunch.name: Hungry Crunch
Hungry Crunch.description: :Steals HP, TP and food effects from a player.

Hurricane Breath.name: Hurricane Breath
Hurricane Breath.description: :Deals {{wind}} damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect, removing one piece of equipment.

Hurricane Wing.name: Hurricane Wing
Hurricane Wing.notes: Used only by Dragua, Fafnir, Nidhogg, Cynoprosopi, Wyrm, and Odzmanouk. The blinding effect does not last long but is very harsh. The attack is wide enough to generally hit an entire alliance.
Hurricane Wing.description: :Deals hurricane-force {{Wind|wind}} damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Blind

Hydro Ball.name: Hydro Ball
Hydro Ball.description: :Deals {{Water}} damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: STR Down

Hydro Blast.name: Hydro Blast
Hydro Blast.description: :Fires a blast of {{Water}}, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Magic Shield on self

Hydro Canon.name: Hydro Canon
Hydro Canon.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.
Hydro Canon.description: :Sprays a torrential aqua jet that deals {{Water}} damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Poison

Hydro Wave.name: Hydro Wave
Hydro Wave.notes: The ruszor will start to absorb water damage after using this attack.
Hydro Wave.description: :Fires a blast of {{Water}}, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Removes a single piece of equipment

Hyper Pulse.name: Hyper Pulse
Hyper Pulse.notes: Used by Omega, Proto-Omega and Pantokrator. Bind effect has a very short duration. Proto-Omega and Pantokrator inflict Weight.
Hyper Pulse.description: :Deals damage to players within an area of effect. Additional effects: Bind + Weight

Hypnic Lamp.name: Hypnic Lamp
Hypnic Lamp.notes: Can't use this if its eyestalks are destroyed.
Hypnic Lamp.description: :Attempts to hypnotize targets in an area of effect.

Hypnogenesis.name: Hypnogenesis
Hypnogenesis.description: :Deals critical damage to a player with a gaze.

Hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
Hypnosis.notes: Players must be facing the Ahriman to be affected by the gaze attack.
Hypnosis.description: :Puts target in a cone area of effect in sight to sleep.

Hypnotic Sway.name: Hypnotic Sway
Hypnotic Sway.description: :Inflicts Amnesia on a single target with a gaze attack.

Hypothermal Combustion.name: Hypothermal Combustion
Hypothermal Combustion.notes: Damage is based on remaining HP

Iainuki.name: Iainuki
Iainuki.notes: Used only by Kurt during Campaign & Trust: Gilgamesh. Causes a knockback effect on all enemies hit.
Iainuki.description: :Blows enemies away with a powerful blade slash.

Ice Roar.name: Ice Roar
Ice Roar.notes: Used only by Gigas in the Northlands, campaign battles, and in Limbus.
Ice Roar.description: :Emits a wintry roar, dealing {{Ice}} damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Ichor Stream.name: Ichor Stream
Ichor Stream.description: :Spews venomous ichor at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Ill Wind.name: Ill Wind
Ill Wind.notes: Only used by Puks in Mamook, Besieged, and the following Notorious Monsters: Vulpangue, Nis Puk, Nguruvilu, Seps , Phantom Puk and Waugyl. Dispels one effect.
Ill Wind.description: :Deals {{Wind}} damage to enemies within an area of effect. Additional effect: Dispel

Immortal Anathema.name: Immortal Anathema
Immortal Anathema.description: :Inflicts a curse on all targets in an area of effect.

Immortal Shield.name: Immortal Shield
Immortal Shield.notes: **When used, the Soulflayer gains a visable shield that rotates around its body.
Immortal Shield.description: :Grants a Magic Shield to the user.

Impact Roar.name: Impact Roar
Impact Roar.description: :Emits the roar of an impact event, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Impact Stream.name: Impact Stream
Impact Stream.description: :Damages all nearby targets. Additional effect: Stun & Defense Down

Impale.name: Impale
Impale.description: :Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis

Impalement.name: Impalement
Impalement.notes: Inflicts damage similarly to the Tonberry attack Throat Stab; as such, it will normally never inflict a K.O. on its target, but generally leaves it at approximately 5% remaining HP. Only used by Craver NMs. Similar to Murk, Slow effect has low priority can be overwritten/blocked by Haste.Yearner and Usurper can occasionally score greatly increased damage with this attack, causing an immediate K.O. without adequate physical damage reduction.
Impalement.description: :Impales a single target, leaving it near death. Additional effect: Slow + resets enmity

Implosion.name: Implosion
Implosion.notes: Only uses this ability during his second phase, every 10 seconds. Heralded by a distinct sound & visual effect, it will hit almost everyone in the battlefield due to large range.
Implosion.description: :Channels a wave of negative energy, damaging all targets in very wide area of effect.
